Every search represents someone seeking reliable information. They depend on search results being accurate, trustworthy, and relevant to their local context. But search engines only learn to return trustworthy information if human evaluators with deep research expertise and cultural knowledge verify and correct them. Your linguistic precision, fact-checking rigor, and understanding of how your culture communicates and values information is irreplaceable in building search systems that people can actually trust.

 

In this role, you will evaluate search queries, results, and AI-generated content for factual accuracy, authority, relevance, and user intent alignment. Your judgment determines whether search systems return trustworthy, contextually appropriate information.

 

  • Analyze multi-turn search queries and web results for factual accuracy, source authority, and user intent alignment
  • Conduct cross-referencing and fact-checking using regional sources, specialized databases, academic resources, and web directories
  • Assess localized content relevancy across diverse domains—news, sports, local culture, technical queries considering regional context and cultural nuance
  • Evaluate AI-generated content for factual grounding, hallucination risk, and contextual appropriateness
  • Provide structured assessments that train search ranking and content relevance models

 

Qualifications to succeed in this project:

 

  • Professional fluency in English
  • Residency in the United States for the last 3 consecutive years  
  • Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Deep local cultural awareness and familiarity with regional news, current events, and contemporary culture
  • Strong fact-checking and critical thinking abilities
  • Access to a stable broadband internet, a reliable computer and a smartphone (Android 5.0, iOS 14 or higher)
  • Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Linguists, cross-cultural researchers, domain specialists, and detail-driven professionals with strong research methodology (preferred)

 

Why join the project:

 

  • Fully remote flexibility: Structure your contributions around research, consulting, teaching, or other professional commitments without rigid scheduling
  • Comprehensive research support: Access detailed evaluation guidelines, reference materials, databases, and resources for fact-checking across domains
  • Quality recognition: Performance assessments focused on consistency, fact-checking precision, and nuanced judgment
  • Intellectually demanding by design: If you are driven by fact-checking precision, source authority analysis, and the challenge of identifying what makes information truly trustworthy, this work is built for that mindset.
  • Responsive support: Direct access to evaluation support staff for clarification on ambiguous queries or technical guidance
  Qualification path

How to get started:

  • Complete your contributor profile and application

  • Verify your identity through our secure identity verification process
  • Acceptance form & Rater Academy: Complete an acceptance form and approximately 2.5 hours of Rater Academy training

Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines.

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time.

Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect!

As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions.

You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality.

  • Optimize LLM inference for low latency and cost, using caching and asynchronous processing.

Back-End

Front-End

Nice-to-Have Technical Skills

  • Excellent communication, thriving in remote and cross-team collaboration

  • Impactful Work: Build AI-powered tools that help millions of investors make informed decisions from data-driven insights.

Metics Media is a small, fully remote team creating high-quality YouTube videos about software, digital marketing, and AI tools for an audience of over 700,000 subscribers. Our mission is simple: to make technology easy to understand and help people get the most out of the tools available to them.

We partner with leading platforms like Shopify, Hostinger, and Squarespace, allowing us to keep our content free and accessible to everyone.

We're now looking for talented, motivated content creators to join our growing team, help us produce even more high-quality videos, and reach millions more people around the world.


What you'll do
  • Research each video's topic and tools in depth, and figure out what to cover and how to present it in a clear, engaging way.
  • Write video scripts and outlines.
  • Record videos, including talking-head and screen recordings. Your face will be visible in your videos.

What we're looking for
  • Native-level written and spoken English
  • Strong on-camera presentation skills and the ability to communicate clearly and confidently

  • Reliable, organized, and able to work independently and take ownership of your projects

  • A quiet, dedicated workspace where you can work without interruptions, with room to set up a small studio for recording talking-head videos with minimal background noise
  • Fast internet connection with at least 50 Mbps download and 25 Mbps upload
  • Legal authorization to work in the US or Canada


Nice to have
  • Previous experience creating educational video content
  • Knowledge of topics such as website creation, AI tools, ecommerce, or other areas we regularly create videos about
  • Equipment needed to produce high-quality videos


Working at Metics Media

At Metics Media, you'll have a lot of freedom in how you work. You'll be trusted to structure your own day, manage your projects independently, and take ownership of your work. Role Overview:

  • Prescription Fulfillment: Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount.

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

What we’re looking for

  • Strong proficiency in React, Next.js, TypeScript/JavaScript.

  • Hands-on experience with AWS for production workloads.

  • Solid understanding of web security best practices (OWASP, secure storage, encryption in transit/at rest, secrets management).

  • Experience building systems in or adjacent to healthcare, education, or compliance-heavy environments is a plus.

  • Excellent async communication, code ownership, and ability to work with a small, senior-led team.

  • Comfort working from a clear product brief and also proposing improvements proactively.

  • Familiarity with logging, monitoring, and observability tools.

Take-home assignment (Step 1 of the process)

Please complete a take-home assignment. You are allowed to use LLMs to write code. To ensure that your work will not be used at Fluence, we’ve made it unrelated to healthcare:

Build “LendLoop”: a neighborhood tool-lending board with automated workflows

A simple app where neighbors list tools they are willing to lend, request to borrow from each other, and receive automated notifications and reminders handled by n8n.

Stack

  • Next.js (App Router)

  • Clerk for authentication

  • Convex for data + backend logic

  • n8n (self-hosted via Docker or n8n Cloud) for workflow automation

  • TypeScript

Requirements

Public page

  • The fictional company name is LendLoop.

  • Short tagline, e.g. “Borrow what you need. Lend what you don’t.”

  • Show:

  • A “Sign in to lend or borrow” button wired to Clerk.

Authenticated experience

  • Only signed-in users can:

  • List a tool with:

  • name

  • category (power tools, garden, kitchen, camping, etc.)

  • condition

  • short description

  • Request to borrow a tool for a date range.

  • Approve or decline requests on their own tools.

  • Mark a loan as returned.

  • Show:

  • All tools with availability status, filterable by category.

  • “My listings”, “My requests”, and “Incoming requests” views.

  • Nice, minimal layout.

Roles & rules

  • admin:

  • user:

    • Can create, edit, and delete only their own listings, and act only on requests involving their own tools or their own borrowing.

  • Implement the above role-based access control with best practices, enforced in Convex functions, not only in the UI.

With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there.

If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you!

Job Overview

As a Clinical Operations Lead, you will provide clinical operations oversight for projects at a regional or global level, ensuring study deliverables, CRA activities and investigator sites are managed in accordance with the protocol, monitoring plan, ICH-GCP guidelines and applicable local regulations. You will act as a key liaison between CRAs and the clinical project team, providing operational guidance, training and oversight throughout the study.

The role will also support site start-up and feasibility, recruitment and enrolment strategies, monitoring performance, issue escalation and corrective actions, while contributing to study planning, documentation and overall project delivery.

Key Responsabilities

  • Provide oversight of regional CRAs and investigator sites, ensuring compliance with study protocols, monitoring plans, ICH-GCP, local regulations and study timelines.
  • Conduct co-monitoring and CRA assessment visits as required, supporting site and CRA performance and ensuring monitoring standards are maintained.
  • Proactively monitor site and country performance, including recruitment, data collection, document collection and TMF activities, and communicate progress to the clinical project team.
  • Oversee regional site start-up and feasibility activities and support vendor management activities where required.
  • Review monitoring visit reports for quality, compliance and appropriate site management, ensuring project deliverables are completed accurately and on time.
  • Serve as a key point of contact for regional CRAs, providing study-specific guidance, resolving issues and escalating matters to the Project Manager or relevant functions when appropriate.
  • Provide training and mentoring to CRAs on study procedures, clinical plans, guidelines and timelines, and ensure study-specific training is completed and documented.
  • Participate in Sponsor meetings and CRA calls, providing updates on country and site performance and operational progress.
  • Develop and implement enrolment and recruitment strategies and create study tools, training materials, monitoring plans and other clinical operations documentation.
  • Support the clinical project team with study deliverables, presentations, site management activities, protocol deviations, financial project activities and other operational objectives as required.

Skills & Qualifications

  • 4–6 years of relevant clinical research experience required, with 7–9 years preferred.
  • Minimum 3 years of CRA experience, with strong hands-on understanding of clinical monitoring activities.
  • Post-secondary certificate/diploma required; a Bachelor’s degree in Health Sciences, Life Sciences, Nursing or a related discipline is preferred.
  • Strong understanding of ICH-GCP, local regulations, IRB/EC requirements and Investigator responsibilities as they relate to clinical monitoring.
  • Experience working with EDC systems and clinical research documentation.
  • Strong understanding of clinical trial processes, site management, monitoring activities and study performance metrics.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate with CRAs, Sponsors, investigators and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong organisational, interpersonal and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a dynamic environment.
  • Highly proactive, detail-oriented, task-driven and organised, with strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and demonstrated ability to prepare high-quality reports, presentations and clinical research documentation.
  • SoCRA and/or ACRP certification/designation is an advantage.

  • Central medical imaging management and endoscopic reading
  • Precision medicine and biomarker solutions
  • Real-world evidence and clinical consulting
  • Histopathology and lab services through AcelaBio

To apply for this position, please submit your resume through the Alimentiv Careers Portal or via LinkedIn’s Easy Apply. Resumes must be submitted in English.

Alimentiv is committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Accommodations are available upon request for persons with disabilities throughout the recruitment and selection process. Requests can be directed to recruitment@alimentiv.com.

About the Client

Founded in 2014 as a dating app, Feeld gathered millions of users in one place to create a safer and more inclusive space online for everyone open to experiencing people and relationships in a new way. Their mission is to elevate the human experience of sexuality and relationships and create a world where everyone is more intimately connected to each other and themselves.

About the Project

You'll join a consumer mobile product with an engineering and product organization of around 50 people distributed across Europe, the US, and LATAM.

The engineering organization works in small, autonomous product squads supported by a dedicated Infrastructure Team responsible for building and maintaining the secure, scalable, and reliable cloud infrastructure that powers Feeld.

The team is focused on evolving its AWS infrastructure through Infrastructure as Code, automation, and resilient architecture. You will provide technical expertise, day-to-day operational ownership, and customer advocacy to ensure stakeholders achieve their mission objectives using DedroneTracker.AI, RF sensors, radar, and EO/IR camera systems.   • Maintain and administer deployment records, including shipment tracking and RMAs across overseas territories.
  • Coordinate closely with the third-party in-country installer on site readiness, physical installation, and L1 maintenance handoff.
  • Strengthen technical health with proactive reviews, release readiness, and performance guidance.

What You Bring

  • EU citizenship for security clearance purposes
  • Fluent in English
  • 5+ years of experience in an IT, network engineering, RF / sensor field engineering, or technical deployment role.
  • Proven track record of managing customer relationships and technical projects successfully.
  • Ability to work autonomously to meet objectives with minimal oversight, particularly when embedded with the customer day-to-day.
  • Robust IT background, with working knowledge of:
    • Linux and Ubuntu - SSH
    • Network administration: TCP/IP, VLANs, DHCP, DNS, SSH, firewalls, VPNs, LTE backhaul.
    • Basic SQL, certificate management.
    • On-prem, offline / air-gapped, and cloud deployment models.
    • Active Directory / Entra ID and identity integration patterns.
    • API integrations and SaaS application administration.
  • Solid ability to tailor technical discussions to varied audiences — from operators and field users to technical authorities and executive sponsors.
  • Strong documentation discipline — architecture diagrams, runbooks, S2S handover packs, operator training materials.
  • Comfortable maintaining a home lab and learning new sensor / RF / radar / EO/IR technologies at depth.

  • Counter UAS or drone pilot experience
  • Experience working with law enforcement, defense, or government entities — strongly preferred.

About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

As the General Manager for Communication, Media, Entertainment, & Technology (CMET) at Toptal, you will be the visionary architect of our growth strategy in this dynamic industry. We’re seeking a hands-on leader with an entrepreneurial spirit who can inspire and scale a world-class team to drive exponential growth in our enterprise customer base.

In this high-impact role, you will collaborate with Senior Leadership to unlock transformative market opportunities and identify the highest-potential avenues for value creation. Your strategic insight and foresight will be pivotal in shaping the future of Toptal’s presence in the CMET landscape.

You will lead from the front, rolling up your sleeves to work directly with your sales team in forging and nurturing relationships with Fortune 500 companies. Your ability to strategically target and close deals will be integral to our success, positioning Toptal as a leader in the industry.

If you are a strategic thinker with a passion for driving growth, a knack for crafting compelling strategies, and the ability to execute at the highest level, we want to hear from you.

This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Define strategy & execute tactics to acquire key target prospects while deepening strategic relationships with CMET portfolio clients.
  • Cultivate relationships with Senior leaders at accounts in your team’s portfolio.
  • Leverage your professional network connections to expand reach within your industry.
  • Develop hypotheses to drive the team’s Go-to-Market Strategy and expand Toptal’s presence within Communication, Media, Entertainment, & Technology.
  • Develop & prioritize industry-specific offerings in alignment with Category Service Leaders
  • Evaluate and evolve the team’s short-, medium-, and long-term plan to establish Toptal as the leading provider of professional services in the enterprise space.
  • Develop account prioritization criteria and work with members of the team to optimize account portfolios and engagement strategies.
  • Develop account plans and relationship maps by leveraging industry insights.
  • Lead a team of experienced Sales & Client Services professionals to expand Toptal’s professional services market share within the Communication, Media, Entertainment, and Technology industries.
  • Regularly meet with Sales Director & CMET team members to review KPIs, provide guidance to increase deal velocity, evaluate performance, and develop coaching plans.
  • Lead with both inspiration and accountability, establishing clear performance standards, providing direct feedback in real time, and driving execution through focused, consistent coaching.
  • Actively recruit new members to join our rapidly growing team

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
  • Learn Toptal’s model, our value proposition, and our story.
  • Learn our sales method and our selling process.
  • Meet the team and understand targets and goals.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Build your initial GTM strategy for CMET in partnership with Services GMs, iterating based on feedback from clients while exercising discretion and independent judgment.
  • Get up to speed on your industry territory and understand priority focus areas at the portfolio level
  • Develop a performance cadence with the team to review key metrics (e.g., activity, conversion, etc.) and identify specific areas for improvement.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Roll out a focused industry strategy to align the team around clear goals, tactics, and go-to-market priorities across the CMET.
  • Scale growth with existing clients and have a defined strategy to procure high-potential net-new clients.
  • Engage with services stakeholders to develop coordinated strategies designed to accelerate and diversify growth while strengthening client relationships.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Secure initial traction within the CMET sector by closing new enterprise logos and expanding opportunities with existing clients, laying the groundwork for accelerated growth.
  • Assess current team structure and capabilities, making necessary changes to ensure the right team is in place to support near-term opportunity and long-term growth goals.
  • Establish clear team and individual performance objectives, aligning efforts around pipeline generation, sales velocity, and account development to drive early momentum.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Achieve quarterly and annual growth objectives by setting clear performance expectations across the team, leading business reviews, and coaching through deal cycles.
  • Demonstrate your ability to coach and develop the team to achieve ambitious goals while continuously improving pipeline health, close rates, and exceptional client outcomes.
  • Expand the team’s portfolio by securing five or more new Fortune 500 clients, deepen relationships with existing clients, and promote growth through Toptal’s suite of offerings.
  • Partner with Toptal Leadership to design and operationalize a 12-month growth plan for CMET through focused industry segmentation, strategic account targeting, and effective resource alignment.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required. Master’s degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field preferred.
  • 15+ years of experience in Professional Services, including 5+ years leading sales teams in Communication, Media, Entertainment, & Technology.
  • 5+ years of in-market experience running and managing an industry business unit. Must have current, deep industry relationships at the leadership level within CMET.
  • Experience establishing high-impact, revenue-generating commercial relationships, with a proven track record of success in building credibility across all levels of an organization. You can develop positive relationships across the business to partner on key initiatives and gain consensus on processes and strategies.
  • Minimum of 10 years experience building client portfolios of $20M+ with a blended team of hunters and farmers
  • A well-rounded understanding of emerging technologies and the ability to have an informed discussion about software delivery and development concepts with prospective clients.
  • Recent experience selling large, complex, multi-phase, managed technology projects to enterprise clients with $2B+ in annual revenue.
  • P&L experience with a strong understanding of business operations and management principles.
  • Skilled at fostering positive internal relationships to align stakeholders, build consensus, and drive forward key strategic initiatives.
  • Experience at a technology or hyper-growth company is strongly preferred.
  • Experience in an operationally rigorous environment with competing deadlines and fast-paced work product turnaround.
  • Ability to thrive and excel in a dynamic, fast-paced organization.
  • Professional maturity, solid EQ skills, and executive presence – you’re an adept storyteller with experience building long-term client relationships and influencing senior-level buyers.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to travel and engage with Toptal clients both inside and outside of your geographic location.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Recruiter (Corporate Functions) to lead hiring across Operations, Finance, Marketing, Creative, HR, Legal, Strategy, CEO Office, and other corporate functions globally.

This role combines hands-on recruitment execution with leadership responsibilities. You will partner closely with business leaders to attract high-impact talent, drive hiring strategy, and help build a scalable Talent Acquisition function capable of supporting BJAK’s rapid global growth.

You will play a critical role in shaping the organization by hiring exceptional talent while mentoring junior recruiters and establishing recruiting best practices across the business.

What You’ll Do

Business Recruitment Leadership

  • Own the end-to-end recruitment process for business and corporate functions globally, including Operations, Finance, Marketing, Creative, HR, Legal, CEO Office, and other key functions.

  • Partner closely with hiring managers and senior leaders to define hiring priorities, organizational needs, role requirements, and workforce planning strategies.

  • Act as a trusted talent advisor by providing market intelligence, compensation insights, hiring recommendations, and talent market trends.

  • Lead recruitment efforts for senior, niche, confidential, and business-critical positions across multiple regions.

  • Develop and execute creative sourcing strategies to attract high-caliber passive candidates in competitive talent markets.

Talent Pipeline & Market Intelligence

  • Build and maintain strong talent pipelines across key business functions to support both current and future hiring needs.

  • Conduct talent mapping exercises across target companies, industries, and markets.

  • Develop strong understanding of global labor markets, compensation trends, and talent availability across multiple countries.

Team Development & Process Excellence

  • Mentor and support junior recruiters, helping improve sourcing effectiveness, candidate assessment quality, and stakeholder management capabilities.

  • Establish recruiting best practices, interview calibration standards, sourcing frameworks, and hiring processes across business functions.

  • Review recruitment performance, pipeline quality, and hiring outcomes to identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Support the development and scaling of the global Talent Acquisition team.

Recruitment Operations & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate ATS data, candidate records, and recruitment reporting.

  • Track recruitment metrics including pipeline health, time-to-hire, source effectiveness, offer acceptance rates, and hiring quality.

  • Ensure a professional, positive, and consistent candidate experience across all recruitment stages.

  • Support compliance with local labor regulations and recruitment best practices across multiple regions.

The Right Fit Has

  • 5-8 years of full-cycle recruitment experience across multiple business and corporate functions.

  • Proven success recruiting for functions such as Operations, Finance, Marketing, Creative, HR, Legal, Strategy, Consulting, CEO Office, or other business-critical roles.

  • Demonstrated ability to hire senior, niche, and difficult-to-fill positions across multiple markets.

  • Strong expertise in sourcing passive candidates using LinkedIn Recruiter, networking, talent mapping, referrals, and other advanced sourcing techniques.

  • Experience managing multiple high-priority requisitions simultaneously while maintaining quality and speed.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence hiring decisions and challenge hiring assumptions when necessary.

  • Experience partnering with senior leaders on hiring strategy, organizational design discussions, and workforce planning initiatives.

  • Experience mentoring, coaching, or guiding junior recruiters is highly preferred.

  • Familiarity with global hiring practices, compensation structures, and recruitment across multiple countries.

  • Strong proficiency with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and recruitment analytics.

  • Excellent communication, project management, and relationship-building skills.

  • Experience in high-growth technology companies, startups, internet businesses, consulting firms, or fast-scaling organizations is strongly preferred.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently delivers high-quality hires across multiple business functions and regions.

  • Builds sustainable talent pipelines for critical and hard-to-fill business roles.

  • Becomes a trusted advisor to business leaders and hiring managers.

  • Improves recruitment efficiency, hiring quality, and candidate experience.

  • Successfully develops junior recruiters and contributes to building a scalable Talent Acquisition function.

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities, ambitious hiring goals, and a high degree of ownership.

Why Join BJAK

  • Above-market remuneration.

  • Fast-track career growth and leadership opportunities.

  • High ownership, autonomy, and direct impact on business growth.

  • Exposure to global hiring across multiple countries and functions.

  • Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership on critical business hiring initiatives.

  • Flat organization where ideas and execution matter more than titles.

The Role: As an AI Applied Value Architect, you will spearhead AI and data-driven business transformation supporting customers in North America, by contributing to your customer’s end-to-end value journey using the Celonis Context Model. Working alongside Lead and Principal VEs, you will combine technical execution with consulting and project management. As an AI-fluent operator, your core mandate is to orchestrate complex roadmaps and execute targeted transformation initiatives that improve how these businesses operate across their Order-to-Cash (O2C), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Inventory Management, and Supply Chain ecosystems.

The work you’ll do:

  • Value Selling & Realization: Uncover the real issues by peeling back layers of organizational complexity. Own the Outcome from first discovery through realized ROI for your process areas. Tell the Value Story by crafting powerful executive narratives and leading business value workshops.
  • Stakeholder Management: Cultivate powerful executive sponsorship across core business units to champion transformation programs. Co-own change management with customer leaders and design CoE roadmaps that build self-sufficiency.
  • Program Management: Steer Global Transformations across complex workstreams. Own and implement AI-driven account planning and AI-assisted project management. Automate executive governance (QBRs, SteerCos) with minimal manual friction.
  • Platform & AI Fluency: Act as an AI-fluent operator, utilizing AI tools for rapid technical outputs while partnering with Applied Value Engineers for deep-dive solution builds. Champion platform adoption.
  • Scale Value & Innovation: Build a strategic expansion roadmap embedding Celonis as a strategic platform to drive adoption. Provide feedback to R&D based on evolving customer use cases.

  • Experience: 3-5 years of experience taking ownership of complex workstreams, process areas, and customer relationships in Value Engineering, Consulting, or Pre-Sales.
  • Client-facing experience: Experience working with external clients and comfort managing client relationships 
  • AI & Technical & Fluency: Solid background in enterprise IT and business software (e.g., SAP, Workday, Salesforce, Oracle). You operate primarily as an AI-fluent operator, utilizing AI copilots to generate outputs and automations, avoiding heavy manual coding.
  • Builder Mentality: Comfortable setting your own direction within an account team. Driven to live for customer value, proactively hunting and ideating for highest-impact solutions.
  • Process Improvement & Value Realization: Proven expertise in executing process improvements. 
  • Strategic Program & Stakeholder Management: Demonstrated expertise orchestrating multi-region or business unit transformation programs. Expert at mobilizing VP/Director-level sponsorship. Flawless English communication with commanding executive presence.
  • Domain & Industry: Deep understanding of the Finance/Supply Chain domains. You stay continuously updated on business-critical use cases.

jobs.description_html:
Headquarters: Remote

About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.

The Opportunity

Carrot’s User Experience team is seeking a Manager, Product Design to lead a team of senior product designers building our member-facing products. You’ll lead project work, raise the craft bar through direct feedback, and help our design function evolve as AI tools reshape the boundaries between design, product management, and engineering. You’ll partner with Content Design, Product Management, and Engineering leaders to deliver products that scale our impact to members worldwide.

This is a true player-coach role: roughly half your time goes to hands-on design work, including design system and foundational direction, and half to leading and coaching the team. If you love sharpening experienced designers’ work, designing for a diverse set of member needs across all paths to parenthood, and shaping how a design team works in an AI-enabled future, this role is for you.

 

What You’ll Own 

In this role, you will:

  • Lead design initiatives from strategy to launch, ensuring work meets project goals, timelines, and business priorities.
  • Give clear, actionable craft feedback through critiques and design reviews, holding a high bar for quality, consistency, and accessibility.
  • Contribute hands-on design, prototypes, or direction on complex, high-visibility initiatives, including design system and foundational work.
  • Coach designers to plan and run their own research, from study design through synthesis, and ensure qualitative and quantitative evidence shapes design decisions.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering leaders on goals, scope, and delivery, and communicate the team’s results and design rationale to senior stakeholders.
  • Drive adoption of AI tools that help designers work faster, more consistently, and with greater capacity, and evaluate what works.
  • Help redefine how design works with product and engineering as role boundaries shift, and recommend process changes to the product development lifecycle.
  • Hold regular 1:1s and coach designers on craft, influence, and career growth, tied to Carrot’s leveling framework.
  • Own performance management, including goal-setting, reviews, and calibration input, and address gaps directly and fairly.
  • Build an inclusive, psychologically safe culture where designers feel ownership of their work.

 

What Success Looks Like  

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

  • Delivered design work on high-visibility initiatives that met project goals, timelines, and business priorities.
  • Established a critique and design review rhythm that has visibly raised the quality, consistency, and accessibility of what the team ships.
  • Introduced AI tools and practices that improved the team’s speed, consistency, or capacity, and helped clarify how design works with product and engineering as roles shift.
  • Built a research practice in which designers plan and run their own studies, and evidence shapes design decisions.
  • Coached each designer with clear goals, regular feedback, and a development path tied to Carrot’s leveling framework, and built a team culture where designers feel ownership of their work.

 

About You

You likely have:

  • A Bachelor’s degree
  • 10+ years in product design or UX/UI, including 2+ years managing designers.
  • A portfolio of shipped, user-centered, member- or consumer-facing digital products, with evidence of leading a team’s output.
  • A track record of coaching experienced designers, giving direct craft feedback, and handling performance conversations.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools to prototype and ship design work, and helping a team adapt its practices as roles evolve.
  • Experience evolving a design system in collaboration with engineers, ideally across multiple products.
  • Strong knowledge of interaction design, visual design, WCAG accessibility, and responsive and mobile design.
  • Experience planning and running user research, from interviews and usability testing to quantitative analysis, and coaching designers to do the same.
  • Excellent communication skills, including influencing senior stakeholders and articulating design rationale.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and change in a fast-paced agile environment, with clear trade-off decisions.

 

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Experience designing configuration-driven products, where rules and settings (such as eligibility or plan rules) determine what each person sees.
  • Familiarity with the healthcare industry, insurance, finance, and compliance, alongside sensitivity to the challenges of fertility health and family forming around the world.
  • Familiarity with front-end development principles (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) to collaborate effectively with engineers.
  • Experience managing distributed or global teams across time zones.
  • Demonstrated track record with strategic headcount allocation, resource budgeting, and external partner management.

 

Why This Role Matters

Carrot’s members come to us at some of the most personal and consequential moments of their lives, across every path to parenthood and lifelong fertility healthcare. The quality of our design shapes whether they feel understood, supported, and able to get the care they need.

At the same time, the way design teams work is changing quickly. You’ll help define how a senior team adopts AI tools, how design works alongside product and engineering as role boundaries shift, and what great craft looks like in that environment, while staying close to the work yourself.

 

Interview Process

We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team.

For this role, candidates can expect:

  1. Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes
  2. Hiring Manager Interview — 30 minutes
  3. Portfolio Review Interview— 60 minutes
  4. Executive Leadership Conversation — 30 minutes

Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role.

 

Why Candidates Join Carrot

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
  • A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.
  • Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.
  • The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

 

Compensation

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. Compensation for this role is structured as base salary plus equity, giving you ownership in Carrot’s long-term growth. This role does not include an annual bonus or variable compensation.

  • Base Salary Range: $162,000- $190,000
  • Geo-Tier Adjustment: Up to $200,000 for highly experienced candidates within 50 miles of San Francisco, NYC, or Seattle.

 

Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com

 

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

Why Carrot?

Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.
